ClientCommand.payload: object; session.new accepts session_mode=chat|study and experiment_run boolean (internal frozen evaluations only); session.model.set accepts profile_id and model for an idle chat session

_payloads.session.model.set: {profile_id: string, model: string}; chat session only, no active turn
_payloads.session.rename: {title: string}; ordinary chat only, no active turn
_payloads.session.delete: {}; ordinary chat only, no active turn
_payloads.session.thinking.set: {enabled: boolean}; chat only, no active turn
_payloads.message.edit: {index: integer, content: string}; chat only, no active turn; index must be a user message
_payloads.message.regenerate: {index: integer}; chat only, no active turn; defaults to the last assistant message
_payloads.message.delete: {index: integer}; chat only, no active turn

_surfaces.cli: 完整会话入口（键盘优先）
_surfaces.web: 本机网页聊天和 Provider 设置

_boundary: 前端不直连 Provider/Memory/Tool；不持有 API Key；统一经 Gateway 进入 Runtime。
